title: Black rice anthocyanin extract enhances the antioxidant capacity in PC12 cells and improves the lifespan by activating IIS pathway in Caenorhabditis elegans.
authors: Li, Xin; Wang, Xinxin; Wang, Kexin; Yang, Xu; Liu, Xiaozhi; Chen, Jingnan; Li, Jing; Wang, Jilite; Guo, Qingbin; Wang, Hao
journal: Comparative biochemistry and physiology. Toxicology & pharmacology : CBP
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黑米花青素提取物在PC12细胞和线虫中的抗氧化及寿命延长作用，涉及胰岛素信号通路，但无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Black rice is rich in anthocyanins, and the antioxidant effect of anthocyanins is recognized by consumers. The aim of this study was to identify the molecular mechanisms underlying the antioxidant activity of black rice anthocyanin extract (BRAE) in PC12 cells and C. elegans. Results showed that BRAE increased antioxidant enzyme activities and decreased the accumulation of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde in PC12 cells induced by H(2)O(2). Meanwhile, BRAE extended the lifespan, enhanced resistance to stress, increased antioxidant enzyme activities, and reduced lipofuscin, ROS, and MDA accumulation in wild-type C. elegans. The polyQ40 aggregation in AM141, paralysis in CL4176, and chemotaxis deficit in CL2355 were alleviated by BRAE administration. BRAE downregulated the mRNA expression of age-1 and daf-2, while upregulated the daf-16 mRNA level and SOD-3, CTL-1, and GST-4 protein expression. Mutational lifespan tests and molecular docking showed that insulin pathway might be involved in the mechanism of lifespan extension.
abstract_zh: 黑米富含花青素，花青素的抗氧化作用已得到消费者认可。本研究旨在鉴定黑米花青素提取物（BRAE）在PC12细胞和秀丽隐杆线虫中抗氧化活性的分子机制。结果表明，BRAE提高了抗氧化酶活性，并减少了H(2)O(2)诱导的PC12细胞中活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛的积累。同时，BRAE延长了野生型秀丽隐杆线虫的寿命，增强了其抗应激能力，提高了抗氧化酶活性，并减少了脂褐素、ROS和MDA的积累。BRAE处理缓解了AM141中的polyQ40聚集、CL4176中的麻痹以及CL2355中的趋化性缺陷。BRAE下调了age-1和daf-2的mRNA表达，同时上调了daf-16的mRNA水平以及SOD-3、CTL-1和GST-4的蛋白表达。突变体寿命测试和分子对接表明，胰岛素通路可能参与寿命延长的机制。
